build_electra_for_sequence_classificatio: build an Electra model for sequence classification with a configurable number of labels
create_electra_for_masked_lm: create an Electra model with a masked language modeling head for token prediction
run_electra_for_pretraining: run Electra pretraining with a discriminator predictions head for identifying replaced tokens
build_electra_for_question_answering: build an Electra model with a question answering head for start and end position prediction
test_electra_model_forward: test the Electra base model forward pass with input ids and attention masks
